status_definitions.NEW: Record a new teaching unit; source IDs are optional background only.
status_definitions.REVISE: Existing source is a starting point; update content or demos before publication.
status_definitions.REUSE: Candidate to excerpt and chapter after accuracy/privacy review, not publication clearance.

modules.title: Start here
modules.outcome: Create a personal learning plan and finish one intake exercise.

lessons.title: Welcome, your path, and your first 30 days
lessons.assignment: Choose role, stage, and first goal.
lessons.production: Record the promise, navigation, milestones, and realistic first-month expectations.

lessons.title: How to use Lewis GPT and check its work
lessons.assignment: Correct an AI draft that invents shipment facts.
lessons.production: Demonstrate Ask, Practice, Review, source links, missing facts, and saving a draft.

lessons.title: Follow one shipment from request to payment
lessons.assignment: Arrange the shipment milestones.
lessons.production: Introduce fictional Northstar Packaging and carry this case through the course.

modules.title: Agent readiness
modules.outcome: Complete a host-brokerage evaluation and approval map.

lessons.title: Choose and evaluate a host brokerage
lessons.assignment: Compare two fictional host offers.
lessons.production: Use a scorecard covering support, tools, customer ownership questions, and operating fit.

lessons.title: Understand your split and payment timing
lessons.assignment: Calculate a sample commission and list deductions.
lessons.production: Record commission bases, deductions, payment timing, and two worked host-offer examples.

lessons.title: Know what you can approve and when to escalate
lessons.assignment: Complete a host-responsibility checklist.
lessons.production: Demonstrate credit, carrier, claims, pricing, and technology approval questions.

modules.title: Brokerage owner readiness
modules.outcome: Complete a launch checklist and operating responsibility map.

lessons.title: Build your launch-readiness checklist
lessons.assignment: Identify incomplete setup tasks and owners.
lessons.production: Verify current requirements and record a corrected setup walkthrough before release.

lessons.title: Insurance, contracts, and operating responsibilities
lessons.assignment: Map responsibilities and questions for service providers.
lessons.production: Review current coverage and contract explanations; remove blanket statements.

lessons.title: Cash flow, customer credit, and payment controls
lessons.assignment: Build a fictional cash-timing and approval plan.
lessons.production: Show a complete payment timeline, credit approval, exposure limits, and exceptions.

lessons.title: Choose the minimum operating setup
lessons.assignment: Choose required systems and assign owners.
lessons.production: Refresh tool demos; distinguish CRM, TMS, accounting, email, and course tools.

modules.title: Understand the freight
modules.outcome: Save a mode-aware shipment intake checklist.

lessons.title: Dry van: information that changes the job
lessons.assignment: Identify equipment and service facts.
lessons.production: Extract the strongest foundation chapter; check capacities and examples.

lessons.title: Recognize LTL, flatbed, drayage, and special requirements
lessons.assignment: Match requests to a mode and escalation need.
lessons.production: Create a concise edited overview; specialized execution lives in optional labs.

lessons.title: Read the documents in a shipment
lessons.assignment: Match tender, confirmation, BOL, POD, and invoice.
lessons.production: Pair selected footage with an anonymized document packet.

lessons.title: Ask the right questions before committing
lessons.assignment: Write a clarification email for Northstar.
lessons.production: Demonstrate commodity, dimensions, timing, equipment, accessorials, and unknowns.

modules.title: Build your daily system
modules.outcome: Save a routine, pipeline stages, and file structure.

lessons.title: A complete broker workday
lessons.assignment: Create a daily schedule for your stage.
lessons.production: Screen-record a day moving between sales, quotes, active loads, and exceptions.

lessons.title: Set up a simple prospect and quote pipeline
lessons.assignment: Build stages and required next-action fields.
lessons.production: Demonstrate one supported CRM or sample workspace from empty to usable.

lessons.title: Organize contacts, documents, and handoffs
lessons.assignment: Complete a folder and responsibility map.
lessons.production: Show naming, load identifiers, templates, access, and who owns each next step.

lessons.title: Run a weekly performance review
lessons.assignment: Save an activity dashboard and next-week priorities.
lessons.production: Record a weekly review using sample activity, quote outcomes, execution quality, and next actions.

modules.title: Find suitable shippers
modules.outcome: Produce a verified five-company prospect worksheet.

lessons.title: Pick a useful starting niche
lessons.assignment: Define a customer profile and exclusions.
lessons.production: Revise C015 with a new niche-selection example; remove unsupported market-size claims.

lessons.title: Find and qualify five real prospect examples
lessons.assignment: Research five companies and explain fit.
lessons.production: Record current sources, qualification choices, and why two prospects are rejected.

lessons.title: Find the right contact and verify the facts
lessons.assignment: Attach source links and contact-confidence notes.
lessons.production: Refresh research tools; separate public facts from assumed freight needs.

lessons.title: Use AI to prepare a relevant approach
lessons.assignment: Turn verified research into a concise call brief.
lessons.production: Show input facts, AI assistance, fact checks, and an edited opener.

modules.title: Start useful sales conversations
modules.outcome: Save outreach messages and a follow-up schedule.

lessons.title: Understand the sales cycle and your value

lessons.production: Use C015 to explain acquisition principles; add a sales-cycle diagram and specific value example.

lessons.title: Prepare and open a first call
lessons.assignment: Practice a gatekeeper and decision-maker call.
lessons.production: Record an annotated first call from preparation to gatekeeper, decision-maker, and agreed next step.

lessons.title: Discover the reason behind an objection
lessons.assignment: Replay an objection after feedback.
lessons.production: Use C019 contact scenarios and add an objection debrief and practice rubric.

lessons.title: Use email and LinkedIn together
lessons.assignment: Draft a profile improvement and outreach pair.
lessons.production: Merge overlapping material and refresh interface demonstrations.

lessons.title: From first conversation to quote request
lessons.assignment: Build a follow-up plan for a fictional account.
lessons.production: Show several complete exchanges, next actions, and the handoff into intake.

modules.title: Quote with confidence

lessons.title: Predict carrier cost using evidence
lessons.assignment: Compare supplied rate evidence and uncertainty.
lessons.production: Chapter the Quote Masterclass and replace dated tool demonstrations.

lessons.title: Margin, markup, and all-in cost

lessons.production: Correct ambiguous language; use a deterministic calculator and worked examples.

lessons.title: Build a complete quote and explain assumptions

lessons.title: Handle negotiation, spot work, and RFQs
lessons.assignment: Respond to a price objection and an RFQ request.
lessons.production: Select chapters; label scenario assumptions and source dates.

lessons.title: Practice lab: fix the weak quote
lessons.assignment: Submit a corrected quote and explain three decisions.
lessons.production: Short briefing and debrief; show errors in equipment, cost assumptions, and wording.

modules.title: Cover and execute the shipment
modules.outcome: Save a carrier and shipment execution checklist.

lessons.title: Verify carrier information and spot mismatches
lessons.assignment: Resolve an identity mismatch using an approval policy.
lessons.production: Update checks with current reviewed procedures; show an agent escalation variant.

lessons.title: Source capacity and pitch the load
lessons.assignment: Prepare a load posting and carrier conversation.
lessons.production: Retain negotiation principles; refresh load-board screens and supplied facts.

lessons.title: Confirm the order and manage milestones
lessons.assignment: Build a confirmation and milestone record.
lessons.production: Use selected instruction and a new fictional shipment packet.

lessons.title: Close out the load and make it invoice-ready
lessons.assignment: Find missing closeout evidence and route a dispute.
lessons.production: Demonstrate document checks, charge approval, and agent/owner handoffs.

modules.title: Handle difficult situations
modules.outcome: Save communication and exception response templates.

lessons.title: Communicate a delay while recovery is underway
lessons.assignment: Draft a fact-based update and next-update time.
lessons.production: Clarify older solution-first advice; demonstrate prompt material updates.

lessons.title: Collect facts and escalate a freight claim
lessons.assignment: Complete a claim-intake and responsibility worksheet.
lessons.production: Use anonymized cases; review process and avoid coverage or liability guarantees.

lessons.title: Work through a shipment going wrong
lessons.assignment: Choose next actions and defend the sequence.
lessons.production: Use C029 communication scenarios as a case foundation; add missing case facts and a role-specific debrief.

modules.title: Improve your book and your business
modules.outcome: Produce a next-30-days plan from actual or sample activity.

lessons.title: Grow relationships inside existing accounts
lessons.assignment: Create an account expansion plan.
lessons.production: Record an account review identifying service gaps, decision-makers, expansion questions, and follow-up.

lessons.title: Identify the bottleneck before adding tools or people

lessons.title: Use AI to review your week and plan the next one
lessons.assignment: Compare an AI summary with source data and save priorities.
lessons.production: Show a bounded weekly review with verified inputs and human decisions.

lessons.title: Run the Northstar shipment case
lessons.assignment: Submit research, quote, carrier decision, update, and closeout.
lessons.production: Record a concise case briefing; build the case data and role policies.

lessons.title: Review your decisions and activate your playbook
lessons.assignment: Correct weak decisions and export your playbook.
lessons.production: Record a worked debrief and next-30-days adoption plan.

modules.title: Optional specialization labs
modules.outcome: Complete one relevant deep dive after core mode awareness.

lessons.title: Drayage and intermodal lifecycle

lessons.production: Consolidate overlap into chapters and verify terminology.

lessons.title: Drayage quoting and documentation
lessons.assignment: Build a scenario-specific intake and charge checklist.
lessons.production: Refresh examples, accessorial handling, and time-sensitive procedures.

lessons.title: Drayage exceptions and case review
